title: Tore
text: Tore. Cat destroyed it after a week. It was pretty flimsy but if you didn’t have a cat from hell like I do, it might be fine.

product_metadata.title: Premium Shower Curtain Liner, 72"W X 70"H - PVC-Free, 6G PEVA Shower Curtain with 12 Rust Proof Grommets And Magnet-weighted Bottom Hem - Moisture Stain Proof Shower Curtain Liner - Black
features: MORE THAN JUST A CURTAIN LINER - Although designed as a Curtain Liner, you can use it alone as the Shower Curtain itself. Ours come in a great variety of colors. So if you are tired of using plain white or clear liners, you'll find these Shower Curtain Liners very indulging!

MOISTURE STAIN PROOF - Our Shower Curtains are made to handle moisture stains. We utilize 6-gauge Polyethylene Vinyl Acetate (PEVA) material to keep these fungi at bay – keeping the liners in pristine condition. These liners are 100% reusable and machine-washable.

RUST-PROOF GROMMETS - Reinforced with heavy-duty grommets, we ensure that this Bath Curtain Liner will survive hundreds of tugs and pulls. These grommets are rust-proof. Even with frequent exposure to moisture, you can expect it to stay in its original, shiny, and clean form.

WEIGHTED BOTTOM HEM - The magnets at the bottom hem add extra weight to our Shower Curtain Liners. These magnets help keep the liners in place and reduce the chances of billowing. Unlike most cheap Shower Curtains in the market, you'll find ours more appealing at a reasonable price.

FITS ANY STANDARD SIZE STALLS - At 72"W x 70"H, this Curtain Liner will perfectly fit a standard size shower stall. For bigger spaces, you can use 2 or more liners. You can find all available colors in the variation section.
